title: Ordinary etale sheaf support and normalized supported germ maps
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative coefficient ring, let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], with open complement $j$. On the ordinary small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], define the sheaf-support functor on sheaves of $A$-modules by $Q_i(F)=\ker(F\to j_*j^*F)$, with its canonical inclusion. Thus its value on an etale $W\to X$ is $\ker(F(W)\to F(W\setminus(Z\times_X W)))$. For a geometric point $t$ of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], define the supported stalk $L_{i,t}=t^*Q_i$. Both $Q_i$ and $L_{i,t}$ are additive. The latter's right derived functor [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] is canonically the geometric stalk of $RQ_i$; the support functor preserves injectives via the closed-support adjunction. Reuse global supported sections $\Gamma_Z(X,-)$ of [def-pur-support-cohomology]. For $f:T\to X$ and a closed immersion $i':Z'\hookrightarrow T$ with underlying closed set $|Z'|=f^{-1}|Z|$, define the canonical natural map $\Gamma_Z(X,F)\to L_{i',t}(f^*F)$ as the unique factorization of the usual global-section germ map through the supported-kernel inclusion. Derive this specified map using exact inverse image. For a further etale map $e:V\to T$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the inverse-image support, define the supported-stalk restriction by its unique factorization of the ordinary pullback-stalk identification. The derived global-to-stalk comparison commutes with this restriction and the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism.
